schema.checked: ISO date of the last verification, YYYY-MM-DD
schema.ids: roles use role-* · capabilities capability-* · projects project-* · experience experience-*
schema.roles_match: target_roles in agent-card.json must project exactly to candidate.json#roles

note: Each capability points to the evidence that supports it. Skills referenced are exactly those shown in Human Mode; no capability asserts expertise beyond what the portfolio documents. Evidence carries qualitative status labels (public repo · external validation · documented experience · self-reported · experimental · repository unavailable); no numeric scores are assigned.

capabilities.name: AI Agents & Computer Use
capabilities.claim: Builds agents that operate real software, including failure handling rather than only happy paths.

evidence.implementation: MCP servers, screen capture, macOS Accessibility APIs, browser automation, verification and recovery engines
evidence.result: End-to-end computer-use loop with explicit verification and recovery stages; no usage metric published

capabilities.name: Multi-Agent Orchestration
capabilities.claim: Designs multi-agent systems with separation of concerns, verification stages, persistence and observability.

evidence.implementation: 5 specialised LangGraph agents (search, extract, verify, synthesize, critique), confidence scoring, Prometheus instrumentation, deterministic CI mode, Docker Compose packaging
evidence.result: 5 cooperating agents, verified reports, one-command deployment

capabilities.name: AI Infrastructure & Autonomous Operations
capabilities.claim: Builds AI that operates infrastructure, and has operated real infrastructure.

evidence.implementation: Natural-language incident interpretation → root-cause analysis → remediation planning with cost optimisation
evidence.result: Early prototype: the incident-interpretation and remediation-planning modules exist, but the end-to-end pipeline is not yet wired together (not claimed as production)

capabilities.name: LLM Systems & Cost/Latency Engineering
capabilities.claim: Treats prompts and inference as an engineering problem with measurable cost outcomes.

evidence.implementation: Rust lexer/parser/AST, ten optimisation passes, four compilation modes, WASM plugins, local Llama.cpp inference on Metal, SwiftUI shell
evidence.result: Up to 80–85% lower inference cost in Economy mode (résumé PDF)

capabilities.name: Real-World Infrastructure Operations
capabilities.claim: Has improved reliability of a live, scaled environment with a measured outcome.

evidence.implementation: One-month on-site engagement strengthening operations on a 400+ node exam-facility network
evidence.result: ~40% reduction in incidents and average recovery time versus the prior comparable period
evidence.status_note: Self-published on the portfolio; employer and raw incident data are not disclosed, so the ~40% figure is the candidate's own account.

capabilities.name: Embedded Systems & Edge Computer Vision
capabilities.claim: Ships computer vision and firmware on constrained hardware, choosing algorithms to fit the resource budget.

evidence.implementation: HSV quantisation and centroid tracking, on-device RGB565→RGB888→HSV conversion, L298N motor control, MJPEG streaming across 15+ board variants
evidence.result: 3 projects, 60 FPS streaming, 15+ board variants, 512 KB RAM ceiling

capabilities.name: Safety-Critical Systems Engineering
capabilities.claim: Has owned a safety-critical embedded subsystem through physical validation.

evidence.implementation: ABS (Anti-lock Braking System) firmware for a 50-member team's competition vehicle; software and electronics integration lead
evidence.result: Validated through track testing, SAE India scrutineering and competition; 11-month tenure
evidence.status_note: Team project; the code is not released, so only the documented outcome can be checked.

capabilities.name: Software Engineering & Open-Source Contribution
capabilities.claim: Has landed reviewed, tested code in an externally maintained project.

evidence.implementation: Single source of truth for -f/--format parsing across builtin commands; 16 tests added; docs updated
evidence.result: PR #190 merged 2026-08-13 with 16 commits; 15+ commands fixed; upstream 2,620 stars
evidence.status_note: Merged upstream pull request, verified against the GitHub API on 2026-09-30.

capabilities.name: Backend & Full-Stack Delivery
capabilities.claim: Delivers complete applications with persistence, APIs and integrations.

evidence.implementation: Resume audit, job scraping, ATS resume generation, weekly tracker backed by SQLite
evidence.result: Working end-to-end product flow; no usage metrics published

evidence.implementation: Canvas rendering, GSAP scroll choreography, live GitHub and LeetCode API integration, Agent Mode record

explicit_non_claims: No claim of published research or peer-reviewed papers.
No claim of model training, fine-tuning, or MLOps at scale.
No claim of employer-scale production deployment of DeepOps or Orchestra.
No claim of maintainership, funding, or stars on the candidate's own repositories.
No claim of Kubernetes experience (Kubernetes is not listed in the Human Mode skills section).
No certifications, awards, or rankings are claimed.

evidence_labels.note: Qualitative labels only — no numeric evidence scores, fit percentages, or rankings are computed. `status` always holds exactly one value from `values`; `qualifiers` holds any additional ones.

definitions.public_repo: Repository exists and is publicly readable without authentication (HTTP 200 on 2026-10-20), so the claim can be checked by anyone.
definitions.private_available_on_request: Repository exists but is private: anonymous visitors get HTTP 404. The candidate can provide access to recruiters on request, so the work is real and inspectable on request, but it is not independently verifiable without that access.
definitions.external_validation: Reviewed and accepted by someone outside this portfolio (for example a merged upstream pull request).
definitions.documented_experience: Described in the résumé published with this portfolio; not independently verifiable here.
definitions.self_reported: A metric stated by the candidate (for example the PromptOS cost reduction); no raw data is published.
definitions.experimental: Early prototype or active development; not a claimed production deployment.
